title: Resume the Interrupted Mission
tagline: Pick up exactly where it fell over
objective: Finish the mission without redoing the work you already paid for.
description: Five steps run before anything goes out: pull the mission archive, plan the response, check the plan holds up, dispatch it to field ops, and log it. Today the relay to field ops is offline, so the run dies at the dispatch - after the retrieval and the planning have already succeeded. There is no block to add here. Wait for the outage to pass, then press Resume from last successful step: the finished work is reused, and the run restarts at the step that broke.
expected_output: A dispatched mission log: the plan, the dispatch receipt and a mission_status of 'dispatched'.

config.prompt: Draw up a response plan from the mission order and the archive. Return JSON with summary, steps and dispatch_channel.
config.system: You are a field operations planner. Keep every step short and actionable.

solution_hint: Run it once and watch it die at 'Dispatch to field ops'. Then use Resume from last successful step. The archive lookup, the plan and the validation are reused untouched - you will see them marked as skipped - and only the dispatch onwards runs again, this time with the relay back up.

failure_scenarios.label: The field-ops relay is offline
failure_scenarios.description: The dispatch tool fails on every attempt, after the archive lookup and the planning have already succeeded.

detail.message: The field-ops relay is offline. The dispatch could not be delivered.

completion_criteria: The mission resumes and reuses at least three finished steps
The dispatch that failed finally goes out
The mission log reaches the Output marked as dispatched

data.summary: Restore Sector 7 power by isolating the failed substation, switching Sector 7 onto the Sector 6 tie line, and holding the tie until the substation is repaired.
steps: Isolate substation S7-B and confirm it is de-energised
Switch Sector 7 onto the Sector 6 tie line
Hold the tie line and report load every 15 minutes
Release the tie once S7-B is repaired and tested

restore power to sector 7.title: Sector 7 grid topology
restore power to sector 7.content: Sector 7 is fed by substation S7-B with a manual tie line to Sector 6. The tie line carries 70% of Sector 7 load.

restore power to sector 7.title: Substation isolation procedure
restore power to sector 7.content: Isolate, confirm de-energised, then switch. Report load every 15 minutes while a tie line is carrying another sector.
